privacyHeroSubtitle: Last accepted on account creation. These documents apply to your use of Confly.
privacyTermsUseBody: Confly is provided for legitimate professional and personal communication. You agree not to use the platform to harass, impersonate, or harm others, distribute malicious software, circumvent security measures, or engage in any activity that violates applicable law. We reserve the right to suspend access for violations without prior notice.
privacyTermsAccountBody: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials and for all activity that occurs under your account. You must notify us immediately at security@confly.app if you suspect unauthorized access. Accounts are personal and may not be transferred or sold to another party.
privacyTermsContentBody: You retain ownership of any content you create or share in Confly rooms. By using the service you grant Confly a limited, non-exclusive licence to transmit and temporarily store that content solely to operate the platform. We do not claim any intellectual property rights over your materials and do not sell them to third parties.
privacyTermsLiabilityBody: Confly is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. To the fullest extent permitted by law, Confly and its affiliates shall not be liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the service. Our total liability for any claim shall not exceed the amount you paid us in the twelve months preceding the claim.
privacyPolicyDataBody: We collect information you provide directly — such as your name, email address, and profile details — as well as usage data like conference duration, feature interactions, and device identifiers. Audio and video streams are transmitted peer-to-peer where possible and are never recorded unless you explicitly enable recording.
privacyPolicyCookiesBody: We use essential cookies to keep you signed in and remember your preferences. We do not use third-party advertising trackers. Anonymous analytics (page views, error rates) are collected via a self-hosted instance and are never shared with ad networks.
privacyPolicyRetentionBody: Account data is retained for as long as your account is active. If you delete your account, personal data is permanently removed within 30 days, except where retention is required by law. Anonymised aggregate statistics may be kept indefinitely.
privacyPolicyRightsBody: Depending on your jurisdiction you may have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data, restrict or object to certain processing, and request a portable copy of your data. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@confly.app. We will respond within 30 days.
